name: particles

frames.best_why: The speck field is spread evenly across the full stage with the brightest and most dots showing.

tagline: Tiny white specks drift on black and scatter from the cursor.
summary: A canvas field of small white dots that drift slowly and push away from the pointer, fading in and out near the edges. A headline can sit on top.
appearance: A black stage sparsely dusted with tiny white dots of varying brightness, densest across the middle. A large grey gradient word sits centred over the dots.
behaviour: Dots drift in random directions and fade out near the canvas edges; the pointer gently pushes nearby dots aside as it moves across the field.
search_phrases: floating dots that follow the mouse
use_when: A dark hero needs gentle motion and depth that reacts to the pointer.
avoid_when: Low-power devices: a full-screen canvas animation runs every frame.
customise: Quantity, dot size, colour, magnetic strength, easing and drift velocity are props; the edge fade is fixed in the loop.
weight_why: A full-screen canvas redrawn every animation frame in a requestAnimationFrame loop.

a11y.note: Decorative and marked aria-hidden; the continuous drift ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Gentle, convincing drift and a clean edge fade; the dots are faint and very small.
